long_biography.plain_text:
Before building Sapio Sciences, Kevin Cramer worked in technology and life-sciences roles at Sybase, Siebel Systems and Biomind. He founded Sapio around machine learning for genetics research, then steered it towards software that helps laboratories manage samples, experiments and data. That shift turned a specialist analytical venture into a broader lab-informatics business.

A private-equity investor acquired a majority stake in Sapio, but Cramer continues to lead its product direction as founder and chief executive. He has championed the combination of scientific workflows with data analysis and AI, and also heads Sigmatic Sciences, a Sapio brand applying computational tools to drug research. His work is in the software infrastructure behind science, not in the clinical provision of care.
